signal: Miva launched Vexture, its AI-powered intent-based search, in 2025 and rolled out the Miva 26 R1 release bringing AI Insights into merchant workflows.

email.body1:
Bill, saw Miva launched Vexture and shipped 26 R1, putting AI search and insights right into merchant workflows.

A platform push like that usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can work before reps are stretched, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Miva off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Bill, quick follow-up for Miva.

With new AI products live, demand often outpaces coverage, and most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit target this quarter. So the gap shows up late, and the quarter turns into a recovery scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Miva needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Bill, last bit of proof for Miva.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Miva's reply rate likely compares to other commerce-software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Bill, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while you roll out Vexture and 26 R1, no problem at all. Timing matters around a launch, and I know it keeps a revenue team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Miva either way.
